description: Gold analytical table summarising recorded hospital operational activity at one row per activity_date and careunit. The table is derived primarily from MIMIC-IV transfer intervals, with ICU activity mapped through overlapping ICU stays. It supports analysis of daily patient presence, patient movement, ICU-related activity, turnover, calendar trends and unusually high operational activity. Measures represent recorded operational activity and should not be interpreted as staffed-bed capacity, formal occupancy rates or clinical risk.
grain: One row per activity_date and careunit.

activity_date.description: Calendar date of recorded care-unit operational activity.

careunit.description: Operational hospital care unit recorded in the transfers source. Together with activity_date, this defines the table grain.

active_patient_count.description: Distinct patients with recorded presence in the care unit on the activity date. This is an operational presence measure and not a staffed-bed occupancy count.

distinct_admission_count.description: Distinct hospital admissions represented in the care unit on the activity date.

patient_arrival_count.description: Number of valid care-unit intervals beginning in the care unit on the activity date.

admission_arrival_count.description: Number of care-unit arrivals on the activity date originating from transfer records with event type admit.

transfer_arrival_count.description: Number of care-unit arrivals on the activity date originating from transfer records with event type transfer.

patient_departure_count.description: Number of valid care-unit intervals ending in the care unit on the activity date.

net_patient_flow.description: Patient arrivals minus patient departures for the care unit and activity date.

total_patient_movement.description: Total recorded patient movement, calculated as patient arrivals plus patient departures.

daily_patient_turnover.description: Total patient movement divided by active patient count for the care unit and date. Null when no active patient presence is recorded.

active_icu_stay_count.description: Distinct ICU stays overlapping transfer-defined operational activity in the care unit on the activity date.

active_icu_patient_count.description: Distinct patients with ICU stays overlapping transfer-defined operational activity in the care unit on the activity date.

icu_activity_flag.description: Indicator equal to 1 when at least one mapped ICU stay is active in the care unit on the activity date; otherwise 0.

p95_active_patient_count.description: Historical 95th-percentile active patient count calculated separately for the care unit.

p95_total_patient_movement.description: Historical 95th-percentile total patient movement calculated separately for the care unit.

high_patient_load_flag.description: Dataset-relative indicator equal to 1 when active patient count is strictly above the care-unit-specific historical 95th percentile.

high_movement_flag.description: Dataset-relative indicator equal to 1 when total patient movement is strictly above the care-unit-specific historical 95th percentile.

high_activity_flag.description: Dataset-relative operational indicator equal to 1 when either patient load or patient movement is strictly above its care-unit-specific 95th-percentile threshold. This is not a capacity or clinical risk measure.

activity_year.description: Year extracted from activity_date. MIMIC dates are deidentified and shifted.

activity_month.description: Calendar month number extracted from activity_date.

weekend_flag.description: Indicator equal to 1 for Saturday or Sunday and 0 for weekdays.

security_careunit.description: Care-unit security field intended for care-unit-based row-level access control.

_gold_timestamp.description: Timestamp recording when the Gold dataset was generated.
